descriptionFull: The Eurasian skylark ( Alauda arvensis ) is a small passerine bird species. It is a wide-spread species found across Europe and Asia with introduced populations in many other parts of the world. The genus name is from the Latin alauda , "lark". Pliny thought the word was originally of Celtic origin. The specific arvensis is also Latin, and means "of the field".
